items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: Clarke and I had a pact, and Nat Pierce, and we had talked about it... Clarke and Nat have gotten all these guys together and we rehearsed and we opened

ctx.x: Oh, Willy Smith, Clarke Terry, Snooky Young, Nat Pierce, Richie Kamuka, Danny Bank, -- let's see --
Jimmy Cleveland, Randy Brecker, Clyde Reisinger, Stevie Little. It was a real strong band.
